instruction: A surreal valley floor tiled as a colossal chessboard: weathered giant chess pieces mid-game, several toppled and cracked with vines reclaiming them, a fallen knight half-buried, moss growing across the dark squares, distant mesas, drifting fog between the pieces, and long low sunlight casting dramatic piece shadows across the board.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Giant Chess Valley. A surreal valley floor tiled as a colossal chessboard: weathered giant chess pieces mid-game, several toppled and cracked with vines reclaiming them, a fallen knight half-buried, moss growing across the dark squares, distant mesas, drifting fog between the pieces, and long low sunlight casting dramatic piece shadows across the board. Style: surreal monumental. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
